description: Shadow statistical-downscaling forecasts (CCA and PCR, version 2; scripts/mos_shadow.py, docs/53). For every cycle from from_year on, both methods are fitted on the cycle's reference years and forecast the forecast year when the cycle is run (before its season); the forecast is frozen and scored once CHIRPS is available. These are the independent validation seasons the method selection needs (docs/50). Never published as a forecast. The forecast year of the 2026 cycles is scored inside the benchmark (outputs/mos/<cycle>/benchmark.json, validation).
